caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a doll or child-like person standing upright, centered on a plain light beige background. The figure has a round face with light skin, blue eyes, pink cheeks, and short golden blonde hair styled in curls. The ears are visible, and a small blue earring is shown on the left ear. The figure is dressed in a long-sleeved green dress that reaches to the ankles, detailed with a pattern of small black vertical dashes across the fabric and gathered at the waist with a matching green belt. The feet are covered by blue ankle-high boots, and the legs are clad in white stockings with thin horizontal gray lines. The figure’s arms are relaxed and extend downward by its sides. At the bottom right corner, the signature “Alex Bush” is visible. The composition is simple, with the figure being the only object and centrally placed against the plain background.
title: Doll - "Guenevere"
